output.subject: PO HH-PO-552: advance request
output.body:
Hello Harbor and Hearth team,

Thank you for your PO HH-PO-552 for $10,000. We are writing to ask whether you would be able to pay a 40% advance on this order. If that works for you, could you let us know whether the advance could reach us by Nov 23?

If an advance is not possible or you have any questions, please tell us and we will gladly talk it through.

Thank you,
Cascade Trade Co.
